name: China Resources Boya Bio-pharmaceutical Group Co.,Ltd
summary: China Resources Boya Bio-pharmaceutical Group Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of blood products in China. It offers blood products, such as human serum albumin; human, intravenous, freeze-dried intravenous, hepatitis B, tetanus, and rabies immunoglobulin; and human fibrinogen, prothrombin complex, and coagulation factor VIII. The company also provides compound bone peptide, oxytocin, heparin sodium injection, posterior pituitary, and carboprost tromethamine injection. In addition, it engages in research, development, production, and sales of anti-infective, diabetes, and cardiovascular drugs. The company was formerly known as Boya Bio-pharmaceutical Group C…
